title: TabGift: A Context-Efficient Foundation Model for Tabular Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16990v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular data generation aims to synthesize realistic samples from limited observations while faithfully capturing the underlying data distribution. Tabular foundation models (TFMs), pretrained on diverse tabular tasks and adapted through in-context learning, have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities, suggesting the potential of extending this paradigm to tabular data generation. However, the strong predictive performance of TFMs often relies on sufficiently large context sets, whereas tabular generation is typically needed precisely when target data are scarce. Extending the foundation-model paradigm to generation therefore requires reliable distribution inference from only a limited context. To this end, we propose TabGift, a context-efficient tabular foundation model enabling both efficient distribution modeling and effective generation from only a few context samples. TabGift maps heterogeneous tables into a shared latent spa

translated_title: TabGift：一个面向表格数据生成的上下文高效基础模型
translated_abstract: 表格数据生成旨在从有限的观测样本中合成逼真的数据，同时忠实地捕捉潜在的数据分布。表格基础模型（TFMs）通过在多样的表格任务上预训练并借助上下文学习进行适配，已展现出强大的预测能力，这表明将这一范式扩展到表格数据生成具有很大潜力。然而，TFMs强大的预测性能往往依赖于足够大的上下文集合，而表格生成恰恰通常在目标数据稀缺时才被需要。因此，将基础模型范式扩展到生成任务，需要能够仅从有限的上下文中进行可靠的分布推断。为此，我们提出了TabGift，一个上下文高效的表格基础模型，能够仅利用少量上下文样本实现高效的分布建模和有效的数据生成。TabGift将异构的表格映射到共享的潜在空间中（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出了TabGift，一个上下文高效的表格基础模型，仅需少量上下文样本即可实现可靠的分布建模与逼真的表格数据生成。
en_tdlr: TabGift is a context-efficient tabular foundation model that achieves reliable distribution modeling and realistic tabular data generation from only a few context samples.
